column5: The milestone-restricted runtime consumes one planner-bound non-null signed-BIGINT equality and preserves duplicate match multiplicity in deterministic left-major/right-minor order through a resumable lazy nested loop. Retained right rows can grow to the complete input; memory tracking, an explicit build-side bound, hash tables, partitioning, spill, concurrent workers, nullable/all-type keys, outer/semi joins, and unordered output remain open.

Each next_batch call stops exactly at the caller row budget while retaining the current left row and right cursor, checks shared cancellation, and fails closed on row-width, key-kind, or source errors. Vectorized probe chunks, selection vectors, collision accounting, other-condition evaluation, and SQLKiller integration remain open.

INNER equality and equality-free CROSS/comma joins project planner FullSchema offsets in written field order, derive alias/original MySQL metadata, and close both same-snapshot DistSQL children exactly once. Outer/semi join miss handling, generic other conditions, default rows, build-side memory bounding, allocator accounting, and all non-BIGINT types remain open.
